title: The poll-exit check re-serializes an already-parsed WorkerReport via JSON.strin…
body: The poll-exit check re-serializes an already-parsed WorkerReport via JSON.stringify(rawReport) then re-parses it through parseWorkerReport, per poll iteration. In production readWorkerReport is makeReadWorkerReport, which already routes through parseWorkerReport, so this is a redundant stringify+parse round-trip. It satisfies the AC and is defensive against unvalidated test/legacy readers, but a parser overload accepting an already-parsed object (or documenting readWorkerReport's contract as pre-validated) would avoid the round-trip.

title: PRD authoring nit (not a code defect): the US-003 AC1 oracle `grep -Lq 'WorkerR…
body: PRD authoring nit (not a code defect): the US-003 AC1 oracle `grep -Lq 'WorkerReportFallback' src/supervisor/result.ts` is self-contradictory (`-q` overrides `-L`), so it exits non-zero for any correct implementation. The criterion (interface deleted) is objectively satisfied. A future PRD should use `! grep -q 'WorkerReportFallback' file` for an absence assertion.
